original_card.question: Does one quantified step of the proposed #4100 all-size construction hold at its actual caller?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read PROOF.md and AUDIT.md in #4100. Select one distinct obligation: CRT total repair, native/free-algebra lifting, precision/conditioning, or complete fixed-tape cost. This is an author-submitted proof, not an accepted unconditional theorem.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Check live handoffs; name one proposition, its caller, quantified domain and dependency closure. Independently prove the implication or exhibit a precise gap/counterexample. Prioritize CRT.md total repair or COMPLEX.md free-algebra lift only if unclaimed. Stop at the chosen obligation; do not substitute finite samples or root arithmetic for an all-size proof, or launch the complete package by default.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: One CRT repair, native lift, precision/conditioning or tape-cost proposition, with its exact caller.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.
Treating archive intake, an author PASS receipt or a finite composed fixture as discharge of the universal hypotheses.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: proposed unconditional construction and finite checks, without independent acceptance.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent proof audit of one caller-bound all-size implication; all other premises remain explicit.

actual_scope: Decide #4237's open question 1: whether the retained fallback elimination makes at most 2(m-r) same-bank swaps for every rank-r projector header, which would make 8m^2+8m-6-5r the exact rank-r child maximum.
scope_change_reason: #4237 proves the rank law, the closed forms and the rank-one maximum, and leaves the rank-dependent bound open as a census observation. This package answers that question negatively with explicit headers; it does not audit any other #4100 premise.
bottleneck_link: The rank-dependent child count would replace the uniform fallback toll in the auxiliary BIT recurrence. The conjectured formula cannot be used as stated; it cannot move kappa by itself.
stop_rule: Stop after explicit counterexample families through the unchanged retained code, small complete censuses and controls; no proof of the true rank-r maximum and no recurrence retuning.
evidence: verify.py runs the unchanged prepare/paid_children path on an m=6 rank-3 header over Z/3^w (w=1,2,3) with s=7>6, and on two block-diagonal families covering every 6<=m<=64 (rank m-3) and every 8<=m<=64 (rank 4), each paying three more children than the conjectured maximum. Complete censuses for (q,m)=(3,2),(3,3),(3,4),(3,5),(5,3) show that the bound holds there, so m=6 is the smallest violating dimension over F_3.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: What is the exact rank-r maximum of s for 2<=r<=m-2?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It fixes the rank-dependent fallback child count. Known: max s >= 2(m-r)+1 for r=m-3 (m>=6) and r=4 (m>=8), max s <= 2m-1-r (#4237), and max s = 2(m-r) on the complete censuses.
open_questions.first_step: Bound the tail-phase swaps in terms of the displaced head rows; in the m=6 counterexample the head phase makes m-r same-bank swaps and the tail phase makes m-r+1.
open_questions.blocked_by: Nothing; it is a finite linear-algebra question for each m.

open_questions.question: Can the excess s-2(m-r) exceed one for some rank-r header?
open_questions.why_it_matters: An excess of one keeps a rank-dependent formula within 3 children of 8m^2+8m-6-5r; a larger excess would not.
open_questions.first_step: Run the hill-climbing search at m=10..16 seeded from family B, or a symmetry-reduced (3,6) census.
open_questions.blocked_by: Nothing; the (3,6) census needs a compiled or symmetry-reduced run.
